description: This file contains unit tests for the InvokeCommandRegistry class, verifying its behavior in advertising capabilities and commands based on feature flags, as well as testing command lookups and metadata.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: Test class for InvokeCommandRegistry functionalities including capabilities advertisement, command availability based on feature flags, and command lookup.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Tests whether the advertised capabilities respect the core and optional features based on default flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that enabling features includes the corresponding capabilities.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Checks that the commands advertised match the core commands and exclude optional and debug commands when features are disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies commands for enabled features, including debug commands in debug builds.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Ensures only motion commands supported by enabled flags are included.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Tests the separation of SMS send and search commands based on feature toggles.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks that SMS capabilities are included when either send or search features are available.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies call log command in the absence of call log feature.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures call log capability is excluded if feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Checks that voice wake capability is advertised even when commands related to voice are not included.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Ensures lookup for camera commands returns foreground requirement metadata.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verifies lookup returns null for unsupported commands.

methods.name: defaultFlags
methods.description: Helper to generate default feature flags for testing.

methods.name: assertContainsAll
methods.description: Asserts that a list contains all expected elements.

methods.name: assertMissingAll
methods.description: Asserts that a list does not contain any elements from a set of forbidden values.
